chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad al-Hamadani narrated to us, he said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us, from his father, from al-Rayyan ibn al-Salt, who said:

I visited Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him) and I said to him: O son of the Messenger of God! The people say that you accepted the position of crown prince whilst showing asceticism toward this world! So he (peace be upon him) said: God knows my dislike for that. When I was given the choice between accepting that and being killed, I chose acceptance over being killed. Woe to them! Do they not know that Yusuf (peace be upon him) was a prophet and a messenger, yet when necessity compelled him to take over the treasuries of al-Aziz, he said to him: 'Appoint me over the treasuries of the land, for I am a knowledgeable guardian.'

And necessity compelled me to accept that under coercion and compulsion, at the brink of destruction, knowing that I did not enter this affair except as one who intends to leave it. I complain to God, and He is the Helper.

key_terms.إكراه: Coercion, acting under compulsion which removes moral culpability in Islamic law
key_terms.الضرورة: Necessity, Islamic jurisprudential principle allowing otherwise prohibited actions under duress
key_terms.ولاية العهد: Crown prince position, the title of heir apparent in the Abbasid caliphate

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Rida accept the position of crown prince under al-Ma'mun?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) defends his acceptance of the position of crown prince under Caliph al-Ma'mun in 201 AH. He explains that he was forced to choose between acceptance and death, drawing a parallel with Prophet Yusuf (AS) who similarly accepted a governmental position out of necessity (Quran 12:55). The Imam emphasizes that he entered this role unwillingly and views himself as one who will ultimately leave it.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Ziyad al-Hamadani narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim from his father from al-Rayyan b. al-Salt. He said:

I visited `Ali b. Musa al-Rida (as) and I said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah! The people say: “You accepted the position of crown prince whilst you present yourself as being ascetic in this world!” So, he (as) said: Allah knows my dislike for that. When I was made to choose between accepting that and being killed, I chose to accept rather than to be killed. Woe to them! Do they not know that Yusuf (as) was a prophet and messenger, and yet when necessity prompted him to take over the treasuries of al-`Aziz, he said to him: “Appoint me over the treasuries of the land. Surely, I will be a knowledgeable guardian.” [12:55]
The necessity prompted me to accept that begrudgingly, by force, at threat of destruction. I did not enter this affair except as one who wants to leave it. I complain to Allah, for He is the Helper.
